name: Alistair Hume
title: Co-Founder
bio: Alistair Hume, the Co-Founder of Axon Park, is a seasoned professional with over 10 years of experience in Unreal Engine and 8+ years in VR design, game development, world-building, and 3D modeling. With a passion for exploring the possibilities of the metaverse, he has lectured on the subject at Harvard's School of Engineering, sharing his knowledge and expertise with the next generation of designers and developers. Alistair began his career working at some of the UK's top architecture studios, and now creates virtual environments that transport users to new and exciting worlds. His dedication to the field has earned him a significant following on YouTube, where he shares his insights on XR, the metaverse, and Unreal Engine, inspiring and empowering others to push the boundaries of what's possible in this exciting field.
